definitions.explanation: The first sign of the Western zodiac, covering people born roughly March 21 to April 19. Also the constellation Aries. Used in horoscopes and casual talk about star signs.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}は{牡羊座|おひつじざ}です。
{彼|かれ}の{星座|せいざ}は{牡羊座|おひつじざ}らしい。
examples.english: Apparently his star sign is Aries.

examples.japanese: {今週|こんしゅう}の{牡羊座|おひつじざ}の{運勢|うんせい}は{仕事|しごと}{運|うん}がいいそうだ。
examples.english: This week's horoscope says Aries has good luck with work.

notes:
The zodiac sign Aries, for people born from late March to mid-April. The {牡|お} prefix marks the male animal (ram).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {牡羊座|おひつじざ}の{人|ひと}: a person born under Aries
- {牡羊座|おひつじざ}{生|う}まれ: born an Aries
- {牡羊座|おひつじざ}の{運勢|うんせい}: the Aries horoscope

USAGE:
Star signs are a common small-talk topic in Japan, appearing in magazine and morning-TV horoscope segments ({星占|ほしうらな}い).
